about_the_game:
This Bundle Contains:


  • Emperor’s Wrath 2D style (for German vehicles only)
  • Unique crew member Goran with Brothers in Arms as zero perk and enough XP for two extra perks (for German vehicles only)
  • Unique crew member Vitarian with Brothers in Arms as zero perk and enough XP for two extra perks (for German vehicles only)
  • x6 Imperial Aquila Decal (for German vehicles only)

NOTE: This DLC is only available until October 7, 2024.

Bundle Description:


Show your devotion to the Emperor of Mankind with the contents of this honorable bundle: one Emperor’s Wrath 2D style, six Imperial Aquila decals and two unique crew members: Sergeant Goran and Techmarine Vitarian, ready to crush any impudent foe who dares stand in their way. For the Emperor!

Vitarian. Primaris Techmarine. Fascinated by machines from a very young age, Vitarian's propensity for all things mechanical did not subside when he was elevated to the ranks of the Astartes. He has a specialist's touch and is often able to coax machinery into performing above its standard ability. He is much more at ease communing with machine spirits rather than with his combat fellows. He keeps the company of machinery, ever trying to perfect the holy relationship between man and machine.

Goran. 6th Company Sgt. Goran is the current commander of the Repulsor Executioner tank. He has a special affinity with the tank's machine spirit, and often applies aggressive flanking maneuvers, using his vehicle's armor to surprise the enemy. Thankfully, his exceptional skill and complete fearlessness allow him to perform these kinds of moves without fail.

Both Goran and Vitarian are only suitable for German vehicles. You can choose their specialization. Both unique crew members have the Brothers in Arms perk trained to 100%, along with enough Crew XP to train two additional perks.

DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.
You will be able to use this DLC only if you play from the game account created on Steam.

  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600 / ATI Radeon HD 4550
